faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BITS Pilani Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Junior Research Fellow position at BITS Pilani is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Graduate/Post Graduate degree in a Professional Course and have qualified through CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or other national-level examinations.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application along with required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37000 per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where is BITS Pilani located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for BITS Pilani, Goa Campus.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age relaxations mentioned?
faq.answer: Specific age limits and relaxations are not detailed in the provided summary; please refer to the official notification for precise information.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I attach with my application?
faq.answer: You should attach self-attested copies of all required documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
